description: Generate scene variants for a model image using either a scene reference image or a text scene prompt.

genOriRes.description: Whether to generate the original resolution. Defaults to false.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the model image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.

realModel.description: Whether to prefer realistic model rendering.

sceneImgUrl.description: Optional public URL of the target scene reference.

scenePrompt.description: Optional text prompt describing the target scene.

sceneStrength.description: Scene reference strength from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.7.

name: nexscope_ai_model_scene_background_replacement
title: AI Model Scene & Background Replacement API
